body: Finally, the long-awaited 189 (Skilled Independent) invitation round is happening now. We'll be back soon with a detailed video breaking down this round.

Received an invite? Congratulations! Our Registered Migration Agent Rahul Dhanda (MARN 2418640) and the PFEC team can help you with your visa application and next steps, so get in touch with us today.
